typography.font_install_instructions: Add Google Fonts links for 'Cormorant Garamond', 'Manrope', and 'Pinyon Script' in index.html.

hierarchy.h1: font-serif text-5xl sm:text-6xl+ tracking-tighter leading-none text-charcoal
hierarchy.h2: font-serif text-4xl sm:text-5xl tracking-tight leading-tight text-charcoal

layouts.spacing: Use generous padding. p-8 to p-24 for sections. Use margin between logical groups. Tailwind scale: p-4, p-8, p-16, p-24, p-32.
layouts.hero: Full height (100vh) immersive 3D scene. Content absolute centered. Dark overlay to ensure text contrast. Use absolute positioning with z-index for text over the canvas.
layouts.services_grid: Bento-style or asymmetrical grid. Mode A: Tetris Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Span items across 4 or 8 columns. Overlap images with text boxes.
layouts.gallery: Masonry or horizontal scroll gallery to showcase high-res interior shots.
layouts.form_section: Two-column layout. Left: minimal quote form. Right: Brand image or contact details. Use custom shadcn inputs with subtle bottom borders (no full boxes) for an editorial feel.

motion.smooth_scroll: Use Lenis for premium momentum scrolling.
motion.hero_3d: react-three-fiber for the 3D curtain scene. Animate vertex shaders or scale to simulate curtains opening on scroll.
motion.reveal: Use framer-motion. Text reveals with y-axis transform and opacity. Staggered children for lists/grids. Image parallax on scroll.
motion.hover: Image scale up slightly on hover within overflow-hidden container. Button hover states with soft gold glow or background fill.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Subtle glassmorphism for sticky header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 with border-white/20).
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid borders in gold/beige for structural elements. Avoid heavy drop shadows. Use delicate shadows if needed.
visual_enhancers.texture: Add subtle noise texture over solid color sections to prevent flatness.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped or sharp rectangular buttons. Primary: bg-charcoal text-white hover:bg-gold transition-colors. Secondary: border border-gold text-gold hover:bg-gold hover:text-white.
components.inputs: Shadcn UI customized. Replace standard borders with subtle bottom border or very light full border. No intense focus rings; use a gold outline on focus.
components.navigation: Sticky top, logo centered or left. Minimal links. 'Get Quote' button on right. Glassmorphism background.
components.3d_scene: Create a Canvas component with a plane geometry using the 'flowing silk fabric texture' image as a map. Implement a custom shader material or use Drei's MeshDistortMaterial/MeshWobbleMaterial to animate draping.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images has sufficient contrast. Use subtle dark/light overlays on images where text is placed.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for 3D and scroll animations.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use react-icons or lucide-react for iconography.
Set up Tailwind configuration with custom colors (gold, champagne, charcoal, beige) and fonts (sans, serif, script).
Build an interactive 3D hero component using react-three-fiber. Use a plane with MeshDistortMaterial and the curtain texture to simulate a draping, moving curtain.
Create a services section with an asymmetrical bento grid layout to showcase Sheer, Blockout, and Blinds.
Create a photo gallery using CSS columns or framer-motion horizontal scroll.
Build a 'Quote Request' form connected to a backend or mock endpoint, styled minimally with subtle borders.
Ensure all buttons, form inputs, and links have data-testid attributes for testing.
Do NOT use completely transparent backgrounds for the sticky header; apply backdrop-blur-xl and a semi-transparent color.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.creativity: Avoid generic outputs. Use layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.transitions: Add transitions for specific interactive elements. DO NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.spacing: Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.alignment: DO NOT center align the app container in global CSS. Follow natural reading flow.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.icons: NEVER use emoji characters for icons.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.components: Prioritize existing Shadcn UI components and customize their styling to fit the luxury brand.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.placeholders: NEVER use placeholder images; use the provided Unsplash URLs.
